metadata.scenario: A patient calls to say that the new occupational therapist is wonderful. She's already seeing improvement in her hand strength after just two sessions. She wants to continue with the same therapist and asks about increasing to three times per week.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is George Williams. I just wanted to share that the new occupational therapist is wonderful! Hi George! I'm glad to hear that. Can you tell me more about your experience? Absolutely! After just two sessions, I'm already seeing improvement in my hand strength, which is fantastic. That’s wonderful news! Thank you for sharing that with me. I really want to continue with the same therapist. Is there a way to schedule her for three times per week? Yes, we can definitely look into that for you. Do you have specific days in mind? I was thinking maybe Monday, Wednesday, and Friday if that works. Let me check the therapist’s availability for those days. Just a moment, please. Sure, take your time. I appreciate it. Thank you for your patience. It looks like the therapist is available on those days. That’s great! How soon can we start? We can begin as early as next week, if that works for you. Yes, that would be perfect. Can you confirm the times as well? Certainly! How about we schedule the sessions for 10 AM? Sounds good to me! Great! I’ll go ahead and set that up for you. Thank you. Also, can you remind me of the cost for each session? The cost for Occupational Therapy is between $105 and $135 per session, depending on the specifics of your care. That’s fine. I’d like to go ahead with that. Perfect! So, we’ll schedule three sessions weekly at 10 AM. Yes, please. I’ll also follow up with the therapist to confirm and will send you a confirmation email. That would be great. I really appreciate your help, Margaret. It’s my pleasure, George! Is there anything else I can assist you with today? No, that’s everything for now. Thank you again! You’re welcome! Have a wonderful day, and I’ll be in touch soon. You too, bye! Bye!
